label: Preprint
definition: Public scholarly manuscript without established completed journal peer review
required_qualifier: Identify the deposited version and repository
does_not_establish: Journal acceptance; peer review; independent validation
allowed_transition: published_journal_article only with a verified journal record
evidence_required: Public repository record and exact version metadata

label: Protocol
definition: Public document specifying planned methods without a completed-results claim
required_qualifier: State that methods or analyses are planned
allowed_transition: results_available only when a distinct results record is public

label: Preliminary operational evidence
definition: Reported observations from routine operational data under stated limits
required_qualifier: Describe findings as preliminary operational evidence
does_not_establish: Completed formal comparator or concurrent-validity result
allowed_transition: validated_result only with a separately published validation analysis

label: Framework report
definition: Repository report whose scope and claims come from the deposited source
required_qualifier: Identify it as a report and attribute claims to the source
evidence_required: Canonical report record and source text

label: Systematic-review protocol
definition: Review protocol with planned eligibility and synthesis methods
required_qualifier: State that no review results are reported and registration is not established
allowed_transition: registered_protocol or completed_review with a verified destination record

label: Retrospective registration companion
definition: Registration created after some planned analyses had already run
allowed_transition: results_linked when the exact results record is added
evidence_required: Registration record, timestamp and timing disclosure

label: Alternative repository version of same study
definition: Platform-specific version of an underlying work
applies_to: RCI Research Square v1 and Zenodo v2.0
required_qualifier: Cite the version actually used and describe one underlying study
allowed_transition: superseded_version or version_of through an explicit relationship
evidence_required: Both repository records and version reconciliation

label: Repository mirror
definition: A public copy or metadata aid for an existing canonical record
required_qualifier: Identify the canonical source of record
allowed_transition: search_indexed or independently_cited only with destination-specific evidence
evidence_required: Public URL, source link and content match

label: Submitted technical check
definition: Correction or review request delivered to a platform and awaiting disposition
required_qualifier: Use submitted or pending until the platform changes
evidence_required: Receipt or ticket plus later public-state verification

label: Public
definition: Destination renders to an unauthenticated reader
required_qualifier: Name the checked URL and check time
evidence_required: Anonymous response and expected content marker

label: Search indexed
definition: A search service returns the exact public record
required_qualifier: Name the engine and query or result URL
allowed_transition: independently_cited only with a verified scholarly citation

label: Independently cited
definition: A third-party scholarly work cites the research
required_qualifier: Identify the citing work and citation context
evidence_required: Citing scholarly record and inspected reference/context
